Pictures on Paper

A portrait photograph at the full width of a printed column stands taller than the sheet it is printed on, so the printer has to decide what to do with the part that does not fit.

A long strip is different: it was made to be scrolled, and shrinking it to one sheet would leave a sliver nobody can read. It should keep flowing from one sheet to the next.

A small mark sits inside this line of text, at the size its page gave it.
